description:
The status of an `order_id` from place_order or book_slot, asked of the platform again when it is not final (paid? confirmed? declined by the owner?). A Shopify cart link answers `unknown` — payment is on Shopify’s side and the shop does not report it here. Free.
Follow the server instructions «HOW TO USE THE VERSUM CATALOG»: results are candidates, not proof; keep reading, quoting, requesting and ordering separate; nothing is sent to an owner, booked, ordered or paid without the user’s permission.
name: order_status
title: What became of an order or a booking placed through this door
